title: Dead-Time Compensator
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Signal Management/Dead_Time_Compensator.md
text: Overcome dead-time effect by modifying reference voltages, 5 inputs, 1 output; {Dead time (s)} sets the inverter switching dead-time 1e-6, {Enable hysteresis for currents near zero-crossing} sets the option to enable hysteresis algorithm for currents near, {Current hysteresis band (A)} sets the current hysteresis band around, {Motor current input} sets the type of motor current input Two currents and {Show enable port} sets the option to enable input port. Values come from the instance.
